written.headline: AMD to invest $1 billion in Meta equity offering and install Helios rackscale systems
written.summary: AMD announced a $1 billion commitment to participate in Meta's equity offering. The chipmaker also began installing its Helios rack‑scale systems and is using EPYC server processors to power Meta's Muse personal AI agent.

written.headline: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model in research preview
written.summary: Google DeepMind made its Genie 4 world model available as a research preview on Oct. 27, 2026. The model creates photorealistic, interactive 3‑D simulations with real‑time audio and lets users edit scenes via text prompts for up to two minutes.

written.headline: Malaysian customs seize $12.1 million worth of advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur airport
written.summary: Malaysian customs seized about 49.5 million ringgit ($12.11 million) in advanced AI chips after finding 30 server units in the airport’s free‑trade zone on Oct 15. The shipment, falsely declared as electronic components, was part of a suspected smuggling network linked to earlier cases.

written.headline: TPG in talks to acquire UK‑based Ark Data Centres for about $5 billion
written.summary: Global alternative asset manager TPG is negotiating to buy British data centre group Ark from Elliott Management at a valuation of roughly $5 billion. Ark operates 27 data centres in the UK and Belgium and runs a joint venture, Crown Hosting Data Centres, serving UK public data centre needs.

written.headline: Indian IT firms positioned to profit from enterprise AI as infrastructure costs rise
written.summary: A research report by Anand Rathi says Indian IT companies can benefit from enterprise AI adoption by offering asset‑light services, avoiding the heavy capital spend of building large AI computing infrastructure. The report highlights rising AI infrastructure costs, citing Anthropic’s $321 billion in future leases and $3.2 billion in sales‑marketing spend.
